svg.metadata: { "component": "seven-segment-indicator", "units": "mm", "geometry_revision": "v6-original-look-smart-glow", "visual_reference": "External appearance restored to the supplied original SVG: same body, pins, segment geometry and OFF colors.", "body_mm": { "width": 12.7, "height": 19.05 }, "pin_pitch_mm": 2.54, "row_spacing_mm": 15.24, "terminal_centers_mm": { "top": [ [ 1.27, 1.905 ], [ 3.81, 1.905 ], [ 6.35, 1.905 ], [ 8.89, 1.905 ], [ 11.43, 1.905 ] ], "bottom": [ [ 1.27, 17.145 ], [ 3.81, 17.145 ], [ 6.35, 17.145 ], [ 8.89, 17.145 ], [ 11.43, 17.145 ] ] }, "segments": [ "a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "dp" ], "dp_mm": { "cx": 10.467, "cy": 15.304, "r": 0.704 }, "attributes": { "data-digit": "0..9", "data-on": "a b c d e f g dp (space separated)", "data-dp": "on|off", "data-color": "red|green|blue|yellow|white", "data-glow": "on|off", "data-brightness": "0..100 presets + low|medium|high|max" }, "editor_contract": { "segment_nodes": [ "seg-a", "seg-b", "seg-c", "seg-d", "seg-e", "seg-f", "seg-g", "seg-dp" ], "terminal_nodes": [ "terminal-top-1", "terminal-top-2", "terminal-top-3", "terminal-top-4", "terminal-top-5", "terminal-bottom-1", "terminal-bottom-2", "terminal-bottom-3", "terminal-bottom-4", "terminal-bottom-5" ], "visible_pin_nodes": [ "pin-top-1", "pin-top-2", "pin-top-3", "pin-top-4", "pin-top-5", "pin-bottom-1", "pin-bottom-2", "pin-bottom-3", "pin-bottom-4", "pin-bottom-5" ], "note": "The editor may control each #seg-* overlay independently using opacity 0..1; the grey shell stays visible underneath." } }
